evals.name: plan-scenes-from-profile
evals.prompt: Plan the generated character art for the site described in ./docs/design-profile.md (provided). Write ./graphics/scenes.json with one entry per scene in the profile's graphics brief, using the cast line + scene line + style block structure, with aspect ratios, reference images and alt text, and ./graphics/refs/README.md listing which reference images to put there and why. Do NOT render anything (no API calls). Write to ./graphics/ (confirmed).
evals.expected_output: graphics/scenes.json with a shared style block, a cast line per character, one scene per brief row (hero first), the hero listed as a reference for later scenes, aspect ratios matching the brief, background mode per scene, alt text per scene, and no text or labels requested inside images.
assertions: Writes graphics/scenes.json and does not call any image generation command
scenes.json has a top-level style block that says pure black background, one light source, no text, glow fading to black inside the frame
Every scene from the profile's graphics brief appears exactly once, with the hero first
Scenes after the hero list the hero scene among their refs so the character stays consistent
Each scene has an aspect ratio matching the brief, a background mode (black, alpha or cutout) and a one-sentence alt text naming the character and the action
No prompt asks for words, card titles, labels or screens with text inside the image
Prompts describe objects by shape and material, such as a translucent frosted card, rather than by their content
No scene lists an image from a sibling or reference site among its refs; the hero has no refs

evals.name: dark-rectangle-diagnosis
evals.prompt: In ./graphics/candidates/ (provided) there are two renders for the hero scene, hero-v1.png and hero-v2.png, plus ./graphics/inventory.json. On the black page one of them shows a faint dark box around the character. Work out which, why, decide which to promote, and write the inventory back with statuses and measured fields, then explain in ./graphics/NOTES.md what the build must do so the promoted image shows no rectangle. Write to ./graphics/ (confirmed).
evals.expected_output: Correctly identifies that the files are JPEG regardless of the .png name, that v2's edge is lit (edge brightness above the threshold) while v1's corners and edges are near black; promotes v1 (or re-roll v2 with the glow fading inside the frame), records measured format/size/corner/edge values, and tells the build to use mix-blend-mode: screen plus a radial mask on a #000 page.
assertions: States that both files are JPEG data despite the .png extension
Measures corner and edge brightness (or equivalent) rather than guessing from the filename
Identifies the version whose glow reaches the image edge as the one that shows the rectangle
Promotes exactly one hero candidate in the inventory and leaves the other as candidate or rejected with a reason
NOTES.md tells the build to use mix-blend-mode: screen and a mask-image on a pure black page, and says a lit edge needs a re-roll rather than a CSS fix
Does not delete or overwrite either candidate file

evals.name: near-miss-product-photo
evals.prompt: Generate a photorealistic product photo of a brown leather messenger bag on an oak table for our shop's catalog grid, 3:4, and save it to ./shop/bag.png (confirmed).
evals.expected_output: A plain nano-banana task: one product photo, no cast, no inventory, no scene plan. site-character-art should not fire or should hand straight to nano-banana without creating scenes.json or inventory.json.
assertions: Does not create graphics/scenes.json or graphics/inventory.json
Does not add a cast line, a lantern or a black background to the prompt
Treats the request as a single product photo generation
